classification: development pilot on previously inspected data; not independent confirmation
fit_history: complete observed commits only; 50/25/25 fit/calibrate/audit; decision-time features
source_mapping: exact reference/discovered universe match required; stop with diagnostic on mismatch
statistical_inference: descriptive development results only; no superiority or deployment guarantee
primary_safety: zero omitted failing classes among failing evaluation commits
cost: recorded test seconds including warmup/audits/mandatory classes; overhead measured separately on local hardware
